name: Sickening Reality
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level antipaladin 2, bloodrager 3, cleric/oracle 2, lathspell 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, spiritualist 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You place a curse on the target that forces them to seek some kind of mind-altering state. Anytime the target is not subject to an enchantment or illusion (figment) spell of 2nd level or higher or if they are not under the influence of a drug, they are sickened. If the target creature is sickened and subject to an effect that also imposes the sickened condition, they are instead nauseated.
